mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona City Hall with temperatures at 59 degrees and an elevated air quality index of 62. Under the new moon, we expect a low of 55 degrees overnight with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote. This long-range strategy, developed with community input, focuses on sustainable growth, diverse housing, and improving our local utility infrastructure.

Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, head over to the Wisconsin State Capitol for the Dane County Farmers Market, check out music at Paddy Mac's, or catch the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park.
On October 3, Verona Police officers located an individual driving with expired registration who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm and a probation warrant.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the OREO Cookie Overload flavor. The shop is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to satisfy your cravings.
